BothEnds.note: 1 … 6 7 8 … 24 inside a complete Pagination. Both ellipses match the 36px page-button footprint, so the row stays on one rhythm.

TrailingOnly.note: Near the start: one ellipsis before the last page. Correct collapse for the position.

LeadingOnly.note: Near the end: ellipsis moves to the front and Next is muted and inert. Mirrors FirstPage correctly.
